name: Biomancer
summary: Biomancer; Universal, Biomancy; Healing, endurance, flesh control, toxins, and forced growth.  Biomancer; When you heal a creature, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.  Biomancer; Your healing powers also end one minor bleeding or poison effect.  Biomancer; Once per long rest, when a creature you can touch drops to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead.
descriptionMarkdown:
Biomancer; Universal, Biomancy; Healing, endurance, flesh control, toxins, and forced growth.

Biomancer; When you heal a creature, it gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

Biomancer; Your healing powers also end one minor bleeding or poison effect.

Biomancer; Once per long rest, when a creature you can touch drops to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 hit point instead.
